name: tuulli
description: Sistema do Templo de Umbanda Universalista Luz de Lion — TUULLI

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server start
